questions.title: Question 1
questions.solution:
SELECT 
    z.zone_name AS ZONE_NAME,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS ORDER_COUNT,
    SUM(o.total_amount) AS ZONE_REVENUE
FROM orders o
JOIN restaurants r 
    ON o.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id
JOIN zones z 
    ON r.zone_id = z.zone_id
WHERE o.status = 'Delivered'
GROUP BY z.zone_id, z.zone_name
HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > 6000
ORDER BY ZONE_REVENUE DESC;

questions.title: Question 2
questions.solution:
SELECT 
    c.cuisine_name AS CUISINE_NAME,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM cuisines c
JOIN restaurants r 
    ON c.cuisine_id = r.cuisine_id
JOIN orders o 
    ON r.restaurant_id = o.restaurant_id
JOIN order_items oi 
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE LOWER(o.status) = 'delivered'
GROUP BY c.cuisine_id, c.cuisine_name
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;
questions.query:
SELECT 
    c.cuisine_name AS CUISINE_NAME,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS TOTAL_SALES
FROM cuisines c
JOIN restaurants r 
    ON c.cuisine_id = r.cuisine_id
JOIN orders o 
    ON r.restaurant_id = o.restaurant_id
JOIN order_items oi 
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE LOWER(o.status) = 'delivered'
GROUP BY c.cuisine_id, c.cuisine_name
ORDER BY TOTAL_SALES DESC;

questions.title: Question 3
questions.solution:
SELECT DISTINCT
    o.order_id AS ORDER_ID,
    c.full_name AS FULL_NAME,
    o.total_amount AS TOTAL_AMOUNT
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c 
ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE LOWER(o.status) ='delivered'
AND o.order_id NOT IN (
SELECT p.order_id 
FROM payments p 
WHERE LOWER(p.payment_status) LIKE'%success%'
AND p.order_id IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY ORDER_ID ASC;

questions.title: Question 4
questions.solution:
SELECT 
    r.restaurant_name,
    COUNT(rt.rating_id) AS rating_count,
    ROUND(AVG(rt.food_rating * 1.0), 1) AS avg_food_rating
FROM 
    restaurants r
JOIN 
    ratings rt ON r.restaurant_id = rt.restaurant_id
GROUP BY 
    r.restaurant_id, 
    r.restaurant_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(rt.rating_id) >= 3
ORDER BY 
    avg_food_rating DESC, 
    r.restaurant_name ASC;

questions.title: Question 5
questions.solution:
SELECT 
    r.restaurant_name AS RESTAURANT_NAME,
    mi.item_name AS ITEM_NAME,
    mi.unit_price AS UNIT_PRICE
FROM 
    menu_items mi
JOIN 
    restaurants r ON mi.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id
JOIN 
    zones z ON r.zone_id = z.zone_id
WHERE 
    z.city = 'Bengaluru'
    AND mi.unit_price > (
        SELECT AVG(mi_sub.unit_price)
        FROM menu_items mi_sub
        WHERE mi_sub.restaurant_id = mi.restaurant_id
    );

questions.title: Question 6
questions.solution:
SELECT 
    mi.menu_item_id AS MENU_ITEM_ID,
    mi.item_name AS ITEM_NAME,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS UNITS_SOLD
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o 
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN menu_items mi 
    ON oi.menu_item_id = mi.menu_item_id
WHERE LOWER(o.status) = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    mi.menu_item_id, 
    mi.item_name
ORDER BY 
    UNITS_SOLD DESC, 
    MENU_ITEM_ID ASC
LIMIT 3;

questions.title: Question 7
questions.solution:
SELECT 
    c.customer_id AS CUSTOMER_ID,
    c.full_name AS FULL_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.restaurant_id) AS RESTAURANT_COUNT
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o 
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE LOWER(o.status) = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id, 
    c.full_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.restaurant_id) >= 4
ORDER BY 
    c.customer_id ASC;

questions.title: Question 8

    o.order_id AS ORDER_ID,

      SELECT AVG(total_amount)
      FROM orders

questions.title: Question 9
questions.solution:
SELECT 
    p.promo_code AS PROMO_CODE,
    DATEDIFF(p.valid_to, p.valid_from) AS VALID_DAYS,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS TIMES_USED
FROM promo_codes p
LEFT JOIN orders o 
    ON p.promo_id = o.promo_id
WHERE DATEDIFF(p.valid_to, p.valid_from) > 60
GROUP BY 
    p.promo_id, 
    p.promo_code, 
    p.valid_to, 
    p.valid_from;
questions.query:

    p.promo_code AS PROMO_CODE,
    DATEDIFF(p.valid_to, p.valid_from) AS VALID_DAYS,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS TIMES_USED
FROM promo_codes p
LEFT JOIN orders o 
    ON p.promo_id = o.promo_id
WHERE DATEDIFF(p.valid_to, p.valid_from) > 60
GROUP BY 
    p.promo_id, 
    p.promo_code, 
    p.valid_to, 
    p.valid_from;

questions.title: Question 10
questions.solution:
SELECT 
    MONTH(order_date) AS ORDER_MONTH,
    SUM(total_amount) AS TOTAL_REVENUE
FROM orders
WHERE LOWER(status) = 'delivered'
  AND YEAR(order_date) = 2024
GROUP BY 
    MONTH(order_date)
ORDER BY 
    ORDER_MONTH ASC;
